results.title: Laos Transfers 74 Telecom Fraud Suspects to China
results.content: Lao police handed 74 Chinese nationals suspected of telecommunications fraud to Chinese authorities on 17 November at the Boten International Checkpoint in Luang Namtha Province. Chinese authorities will continue the investigation and legal proceedings, Lao officials said. The handover followed criminal cooperation arrangements between the two countries. results.title: Vientiane Plans Automated Traffic Fines for Early 2027
results.content: Vientiane authorities plan to begin automated traffic enforcement in early 2027, using electronic police cameras and speed checkpoints alongside digital ticketing and payment services. The plan follows the completion of a central Land Traffic Control Centre at the Traffic Police Department.
